name: Ritu Malhotra
message: They handled the false ceiling, wiring and wardrobes as one job, so I never had to chase three different contractors. Site was swept every evening.

name: Harpreet Singh
message: We moved our office block onto their quarterly maintenance plan. Two years in, we have had no unplanned power or plumbing shutdowns.

name: Anjali Verma
message: Kitchen drainage, exhaust and floor tiling were finished in eleven days, before my licence inspection. The quote did not change midway.

name: Deepak Arora
message: A tenant reported a leak on Sunday night. A plumber was there before noon on Monday and sent me photos of the repair.

name: Meera Nair
message: The carpentry team measured, built and installed the whole kitchen on site. Soft-close fittings still perfect after a year of heavy use.

name: Sandeep Bhatia
message: Rewired the shop overnight so we lost no trading hours. Certificate and load calculation came by email the next morning.
